meta.name: Scent of Time
meta.description:
A young woman's plan to marry the heir to a Chinese incense empire leads to her family's ruin...until she gets a second chance to right her wrongs.

Rated TV-14 · Ended · First aired 13 Oct 2023 · China · Language: Chinese · 45 min
Studio: Huanyu Film and Television · Network: Youku

Complete series. On your server: S1 30/30

On your server — Audio: English, Chinese (from file names)

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: In the tragic aftermath of her family’s conviction, Hua Qian wakes from a mysterious coma and receives a chance to alter her fate.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: While Hua Qian attempts to undo her previous mistakes, her new disposition arouses the suspicions of her husband, Zhong Yelan.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: As Hua Qian attempts to restore Butler Mu’s reputation, Mu Yao gets a job working for the Zhong family hoping to gather evidence against Hua Qian.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: While Zhong Xiwu puts Hua Qian’s character to the test, Mu Yao reveals her true intentions to Zhong Yelan.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As Hua Qian attempts to win over Mu Yao, the Zhong family hires a beggar named Hua Rongzhou as their guard.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As Zhong Yelan overhears Hua Qian’s revealing conversation with Zhong Xiwu, Mu Yao gets an offer from a mysterious thief to clear her father’s name.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Gravely wounded after an attack on the Zhong family manor, Hua Qian finally reveals the truth to Zhong Yelan.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: While recovering from her injuries, Hua Qian requests a divorce, but instead gets her privileges at home taken away.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: As news of Hua Qian’s request for a divorce spreads, the families involved are thrown into chaos.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: At the Zhong family’s incense banquet, the mysterious winner of the annual contest has a strange request for his prize.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: After asking the Princess Royal to grant Zhong Yelan permission to marry Mu Yao, Hua Qian fields an offer for a dangerous alliance.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: While Zhong Yelan prepares to take Mu Yao as a concubine, Hua Qian’s brother Hua Shen finds himself facing punishment for the death of a young maid.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: After Mu Yao accuses Hua Shen of behaving inappropriately towards her, Hua Qian must confront a harsh truth.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: When a distressed Hua Qian isolates herself, Zhong Xiwu takes her into the city in an effort to cheer her up.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: As Hua Qian negotiates her brother’s freedom, Zhong Yelan continues his refusal to grant her a divorce.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: While Mu Yao pleads with Zhong Yelan to set Hua Shen free, Hua Qian gives her father an ultimatum.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Assassins attack Zhong manor during their Mid-Autumn Festival celebrations, resulting in deadly consequences for the Hua family.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: While the Hua family mourns one of their own, Zhong Xiwu finally confesses his feelings to Hua Qian.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: As Hua Qian pledges to avenge her brother’s death, Hua Rongzhou falls into a coma.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: After an uncomfortable run-in with Meng Yifei, Hua Qian investigates the masterminds behind Hua Shen’s death.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Hua Qian forces Mu Yao to help investigate the identity of Hua Shen’s killer and tell Zhong Yelan of her role in the attack.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: While Zhong Xiwu exposes Hua Rongzhou’s past, Hua Qian finally learns the identity of Hua Shen’s killer and his intended target.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Vowing to get him out of prison, Hua Qian enlists Zhong Yelan’s help in tracking down Hua Rongzhou’s accusers.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: After Zhong Xiwu reveals he has proof of Butler Hua’s crimes, Hua Qian must decide how to best move forward.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: As Zhong Yelan and Zhong Xiwu clash over business, Hua Qian decides to take responsibility of her father’s crimes.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Zhong Xiwu goes to great lengths to protect Hua Qian, causing concern among his allies and his mother, the Princess Royal.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Perceiving Hua Qian as a threat to Zhong Xiwu’s lordship, the Princess Royal arranges a deadly plan.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: While Hua Rongzhou remains determined to find Hua Qian, Zhong Xiwu makes major changes to the manor.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: After starting fresh in a new town, Hua Qian finally reunites with both Hua Rongzhou and Zhong Xiwu.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Hua Qian has an unexpected wakeup call that alters her reality – and forces her to make a choice that will change her life forever.
